issues.description: The problem statement explicitly instructs students to implement the Animal name getter and setter with protected visibility, but the provided solution implements these methods as public. This is a structural mismatch that can confuse students about the required method visibility and what they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose one consistent visibility and apply it across materials. Either (A) update the solution (and any references) to make Animal.getName() and Animal.setName() protected to match the problem statement, or (B) update the problem statement to require public getters/setters if public visibility was intended. Prefer option (A) if the exercise intends to teach protected visibility for inheritance.
